page.layout: One printed page, text only. Main text in one column, with a marginal note at the left margin ("Libro 2. cap. 3.") beside the paragraph about the generation of mixed bodies. Lower down, a catchword-like fragment "I. Par-" at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: ut corpus aliquod mixtum ex illis prodeat: veluti caro, os, nervus, &c. prorsus quemadmodum aquæ nimium calidæ contemperantur frigida affusa, donec apta fiat, ut quis in ea lavet. Quo quidem pacto neque elementa, neque eorundem extrema contraria, sunt simpliciter ipsius corporis mixti materia: sed ipsorum elementorum commune temperamentum, ad corporis mixti naturam ita accedens, ut certa species proveniat, a quo & nomen rei inditur. Hoc inquam commune elementorum temperamentum corporis mixti materia existit.
main_text.head: Unde fit, quod corporum mixtorum adeo variæ generentur species?
main_text.p: Ex eo quod elementa non contemperentur sem per cadè inter se proportione. Itaque, si ab igne domi netur calor, prodit aliqua species, in qua uis ignea eminet. Si ite dominetur in cotemperatione elemen torum frigiditas, prodit aliqua species, in qua domi natur aqua: veluti glacies, &c. Sic & caro generatur ex terra & aqua, unde siccitas & frigiditas in ea deprehenditur.
main_text.head: Vtrum ad generatione corporum compositorum necessario concurrat aliquid de singulis elementis?

page.notes: Printed page number "184" is set with a long-s style "1" of the old face; read as 184. The marginal note at the left reads "Libro 2." with "cap. 3." below it, placed beside the paragraph. Words "sem per" and "cadè" are as printed (sem per cadè is likely "semper cadè", read as printed). Text "Ex eo quod" and "Ex eo quòd" are uncertain at the line join; read as printed. The word "Itaq;" is rendered "Itaque" with the abbreviated q; retained as printed in the source. Fragment "I. Par-" at the foot is a catchword of the next page. Several words in the italic passage "Quo quidem pacto..." are set in italics as printed. Some words in the text are slightly blurred and should be checked against the scan.
